source.basis: Operator location page, structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

profile.reading: Aligned Chicago ORD-01 sits at 505 Northwest Avenue in Northlake, Illinois, the first building on Aligned Data Centers Chicago-area campus and the market launch facility for the company in the Chicago metro. Per Aligned own April 2021 press release announcing the groundbreaking, ORD-01 was designed for 220,000 square feet and 48 megawatts of critical capacity, expandable toward roughly 60 megawatts. The facility participates in the Illinois Data Center Investment tax-exemption program, a state incentive for qualifying data center construction, and Aligned location page states it was the first Illinois data center to achieve Green Globes New Construction certification, a third-party sustainability rating. The Chicago campus sits on 18.5 acres per building, and a follow-up April 2022 press release announcing the adjacent ORD-02 building described the two-building campus as planned for more than 100 megawatts, with 108 megawatts of total redundant critical power capacity available across the site. Aligned, formerly Aligned Energy, describes its overall footprint today as more than fifty campuses and roughly five gigawatts of contracted and available capacity across the Americas, with Latin American operations under the ODATA brand. Ownership has changed hands several times, most recently with an October 2025 agreement for a consortium called AI Infrastructure Partnership, combining BlackRock Global Infrastructure Partners and MGX, to acquire all of Aligned equity from majority owner Macquarie Asset Management and its co-investors in a deal valued near 40 billion dollars, with Aligned own materials indicating a close around July 2026 that this research could not independently confirm through a dedicated press release. No specific tenant is named for ORD-01 in any source reviewed.
profile.research_note: 48 MW (expandable ~60 MW) and 220,000 sqft sourced to Aligned own April 2021 groundbreaking PR. Campus-level 100+ MW / 108 MW figures from the April 2022 ORD-02 groundbreaking PR are campus totals, presented as such, not assigned as this building own final capacity. Illinois tax program and Green Globes cert per Aligned location page.

reading.body:
Aligned Data Center Chicago ORD-01 is a Tier III designed facility on an 18.5 acre site in Northlake, Illinois, qualifying it to host continuous-availability workloads. The operator has earned a 3 Green Globes New Construction certification, the first in Illinois under that standard. No IT capacity, total power consumption, or square footage is published for this building.

The facility's capacity is not disclosed, making its scale relative to the region impossible to establish from published data. Illinois has 44 mapped data center facilities and 236 MW of published operational and planned capacity across six facilities that disclose their figures. Northlake hosts one of those disclosed sites. The operator Aligned operates 50 campuses with over 5 GW announced capacity nationwide and in Latin America.

ORD-01 sits on property adjacent to Chicago's O'Hare International Airport, which constrains available land and drives electrical interconnection toward municipal rather than rural power districts. The unpublished capacity makes it impossible to read whether this campus matters to AI compute scaling at regional or national scale. Alignment decisions for this site rest on facts the operator has chosen not to release.
